blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — National Police Commission (Napolcom) Commissioner Rafael Vicente Calinisan warned that criminology interns who violate traffic rules, such as riding motorcycles without helmets, could jeopardize their chances of joining the police force. “We will get their names, identify them, and we will not process their application as policemen or entertain them in the Napolcom exams. Sweeping reforms [are] needed here,” said Calinisan in a Facebook post on Saturday. He called on the public to take photos of “criminology interns” not wearing helmets and violating traffic rules.
